items.description: Architecture and control boundaries are documented.
Core scope and non-goals are documented and preserved.
Versioned contracts are validated.
Core component interfaces are defined.
Hard constraints and policy evaluation are defined.
Model and hardware registries are validated.
A machine-readable artifact manifest validates required artifacts.
Environment and dependencies are frozen.
Pinned dependency lock is present and documented.
Repository structure and local version-control baseline exist.
CPU-first local development strategy is documented.
Remote GPU strategy is modular and documented.
Benchmark workload definitions exist.
SLO definitions and evaluation exist.
Telemetry contract exists.
Failure and recovery policy is documented.
Security and privacy baseline is documented.
Unit and regression testing strategy exists.
Certification gate is machine-checkable.
Paid cloud is disabled by default and controlled.
Required pre-development documentation is present.
